description:
*Objective:* Verify that a signed-in user can add an in-stock book to the cart and that the cart is still there after logging out and logging in again.

*Type:* positive  
*Level:* end-to-end  
*Priority:* high

*Preconditions:*
* A regular user account is available (sign in with it; never use the admin account)
* Application is reachable (local disposable environment)
* Books are located by title via catalog search, never by ID, because IDs change when the database is reseeded
* Book "1984" is in stock (stock >= 1) at $13.99; read the real price and stock at run time

*Test data:*
* Book: 1984
* Price: $13.99
* Quantity: 1

*Steps & Expected results:*
# Open the login page and sign in with the regular user account  
   *Expected:* User lands on the catalog page; the Logout button is visible
# Open the cart; remove every line that is present  
   *Expected:* Cart is empty; cart badge is absent or 0
# On the catalog page type "1984" into the search box and click Search  
   *Expected:* A catalog card titled "1984" is listed
# Open the detail page of "1984"  
   *Expected:* Detail page opens with heading "1984", price $13.99 and an In Stock badge
# Check the Quantity field  
   *Expected:* Value is 1
# Click Add to Cart  
   *Expected:* Cart badge in the navigation shows 1
# Open the cart  
   *Expected:* Exactly one line "1984" is listed
# Read the line quantity, price and subtotal  
   *Expected:* Quantity 1, price $13.99, subtotal $13.99
# Click Logout  
   *Expected:* The Login button is visible and the Logout button is absent
# Open the login page and sign in again with the same regular user account  
   *Expected:* User lands on the catalog page; the Logout button is visible
# Open the cart  
   *Expected:* Exactly one line "1984" is listed
# Read the line quantity, price and subtotal  
   *Expected:* Quantity 1, price $13.99, subtotal $13.99; cart badge shows 1 (cart persisted)

*Postconditions:*
* Cart contains one line "1984" with quantity 1 and subtotal $13.99 after logout and login
* Cart is emptied afterwards

*Traceability:*
* User story: REF-10
* Source: REF-25
title: Add product to cart as logged-in user
